name: Marina Weiler
abstract_title: Stylistic and thematic evidence for authorship compatibility in the mediumistic poetry of Chico Xavier
abstract: Claims of mediumistic authorship—where literary works are attributed to deceased writers through a living medium—raise profound questions about the nature of consciousness, creativity, and authorship. Despite their cultural relevance, such claims have rarely been subjected to rigorous textual scrutiny. In this study, we apply a novel, systematic, interdisciplinary methodology to Parnassus from Beyond the Grave, the first psychographed book of the Brazilian medium Francisco Cândido “Chico” Xavier
authors: Alexandre Rocha, Raphael Casseb, Marina Weiler
position: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry and Neurobehavioral Sciences
notable: UVA Division of Perceptual Studies; PhD from UNICAMP Brazil; former NIH and UCLA researcher
notes: Trained in fMRI neuroimaging before transitioning to consciousness studies.
